App.title: PAIBOT.app
App.description: Explore PAIBOT apps and cloud utilities. We are building tools for operations, organizing information, and automation.

apps.title: Available apps
apps.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, description, or category

study.description: Practice calculations and individual topics with arithmetic drills and math problem sets.

utility.description: Count characters, measure time, and generate passwords with tools for small tasks.

game.description: Quizzes, reaction tests, timing challenges, and other quick games.

daily.description: Calendars, clocks, a diary, and other apps for everyday life.

dev.description: Format JSON and work with Base64 and URL encoding using tools for development.

network.description: Check IP addresses, look up domains, and calculate CIDR subnets.

ip.title: IP Address Check
ip.description: Check the IPv4 and IPv6 addresses your browser is currently using.

cidr.title: CIDR Calculator
cidr.description: Calculate the network address, broadcast address, host range and more from an IPv4 address in CIDR notation.
cidr.keywords: CIDR subnet calculator netmask IPv4 network
cidr.inputHint: e.g. 192.168.1.10/24 or 192.168.1.10 255.255.255.0. Everything is calculated in your browser.
cidr.invalid: Enter a valid IPv4 address with a prefix length (0–32) or a subnet mask.
cidr.note31: A /31 is a point-to-point link, so both addresses are usable hosts (RFC 3021).

siteCheck.title: Website Status Check
siteCheck.description: Enter a URL to see whether the site responds, with its status code, response time and redirect chain.
siteCheck.keywords: website status uptime check status code response time redirect
siteCheck.hint: The check runs from PAIBOT.app's servers (Cloudflare), so some sites may block it as a bot.

verdict.redirect: The site responded with a redirect ({status})
verdict.clientError: The site returned an error ({status}); the server itself is up
verdict.serverError: The site returned a server error ({status})

error.invalid_url: That doesn't look like a valid URL. Enter a URL starting with http:// or https://, or a domain name.
error.blocked_host: Internal addresses such as localhost or private IP addresses can't be checked.
error.connection_failed: Couldn't connect. Check the domain name, the server and its SSL certificate.

supporter.cancel: Cancel at any time; you keep access until the end of the period you have paid for.
supporter.refund: Payments already made are not refunded.

math.title: Math

math.arithSummary: From addition and subtraction to the order of operations and word problems. Start with the easy sets and work up.
math.factorizationSummary: Factor x² + ax + b into the form (x + p)(x + q). Practice for factoring quadratics.

quiz.chooseSet: Choose a problem set to try.
quiz.setComingSoon: This problem set is being prepared. Check back soon.
quiz.saveFailed: Your score could not be saved.

arith.title: Arithmetic
arith.description: Practice arithmetic, from addition and subtraction to the order of operations and word problems, with multiple-choice quizzes.
arith.keywords: math arithmetic order of operations word problems quiz
arith.setAddSubDescription: Adding and subtracting numbers up to 100. Start here if you are new.
arith.setMulDivDescription: Times-table multiplication and division. Every division comes out even.
arith.setEasyWordDescription: Short word problems you can solve in one or two steps.
arith.setOrderDescription: Parentheses first, then × and ÷. Check the order you calculate in.
arith.setWordDescription: Word problems that take two or three calculations. Try these after the easy ones.

factorization.title: Factoring
factorization.description: Practice factoring x² + ax + b with a multiple-choice quiz.
factorization.setStandardDescription: Integers from 1 to 9 - get comfortable with the basic form.
factorization.setWideDescription: Larger and negative numbers up to 20.
factorization.setDifferenceOfSquaresDescription: Only the x² − a² form - good for learning to spot the pattern.
factorization.explanationTemplate: The two integers that multiply to {b} and add to {a} are {p} and {q}.
factorization.setCommonFactorDescription: Take out the factor common to every term, sometimes followed by a formula.
factorization.setTwoVariablesDescription: Factor expressions with two letters, such as x² + 5xy + 6y².
factorization.setAcMethodDescription: Factor quadratics whose x² coefficient is not 1, such as 2x² + 7x + 3.
factorization.setSubstitutionDescription: Replace part of an expression with a single letter, then factor.
factorization.setCubesDescription: Use the sum and difference of cubes formulas, as in x³ − 8.

math.signedSummary: Arithmetic with negative numbers - practice keeping the signs right.

signed.title: Negative numbers
signed.description: Practice arithmetic with negative numbers with multiple-choice quizzes.
signed.keywords: math negative numbers integers arithmetic quiz
signed.setFourOpsDescription: Arithmetic with negative numbers - watch the signs.

decimal.title: Decimals
decimal.summary: Practice adding, subtracting, multiplying, and dividing decimals.

fraction.title: Fractions
fraction.summary: Practice simplifying fractions, finding common denominators, and calculating with fractions.

divisors.title: Factors & multiples
divisors.summary: Use factors and multiples to find common factors and common multiples.

sets.gcd-lcm-a: Greatest common factor & least common multiple

ratio.title: Percentages & ratios
ratio.summary: Learn the basics of percentages and ratios, then try word problems.

measurement.title: Measurement
measurement.summary: Practice converting units and finding areas and volumes.

data.title: Working with data

expression.title: Algebraic expressions
expression.summary: Practice substitution, combining like terms, and working with algebraic expressions.

linear-equation.title: Linear equations
linear-equation.summary: Practice solving linear equations, from moving terms to word problems.

sets.basic-a: Moving terms across the equals sign

simultaneous.title: Systems of equations
simultaneous.summary: Solve systems of equations using elimination and substitution.

linear-function.title: Proportionality & linear functions
linear-function.summary: Explore direct and inverse proportion, slopes, and intercepts.

inequality.title: Inequalities
inequality.summary: Solve linear inequalities to find the range of values that satisfy them.

expansion.title: Expanding expressions
expansion.summary: Use algebraic identities to expand expressions with parentheses.

sets.sum-difference-a: Product of a sum and a difference

sqrt.title: Square roots
sqrt.summary: Practice calculating with square roots and rationalizing denominators.

prime.title: Prime factorization
prime.summary: Practice writing integers as products of prime numbers.

pythagoras.title: Pythagorean theorem
pythagoras.summary: Use the Pythagorean theorem to find side lengths in right triangles.

probability.title: Probability
probability.summary: Learn probability basics by counting possible outcomes.

quadratic.title: Quadratic equations
quadratic.summary: Solve quadratic equations by factoring and using the quadratic formula.

sequence.title: Sequences
sequence.summary: Explore arithmetic and geometric sequences and calculate their sums.

trig.title: Trigonometric ratios & functions
trig.summary: Practice special-angle values, radians, and angle addition formulas.

exp-log.title: Exponents & logarithms
exp-log.summary: Practice exponent rules and basic logarithm calculations.

combinatorics.title: Counting & probability
combinatorics.summary: Use permutations and combinations to count outcomes and calculate probabilities.

derivative.title: Differentiation
derivative.summary: Differentiate polynomials to find tangent lines and local extrema.

sets.tangent-a: Derivative at a point & tangent lines
sets.transcendental-a: Derivatives of trig, exponential and log functions

integral.title: Integration
integral.summary: Practice indefinite and definite integrals and use them to find areas.

complex.title: Complex numbers
complex.summary: Practice complex arithmetic, non-real roots of quadratic equations, and the complex plane.

coordinate-geometry.title: Coordinate geometry
coordinate-geometry.summary: Practice equations of lines and circles, and loci.

vector.title: Vectors
vector.summary: Practice vector components and magnitude, dot products, and angles between vectors.

matrix.title: Matrices
matrix.summary: Practice matrix addition and multiplication, 2×2 determinants, and inverse matrices.

linear-system.title: Linear systems & matrices
linear-system.summary: Solve systems of linear equations using row reduction and determine the number of solutions.

eigen.title: Eigenvalues & eigenvectors

rounding.title: Rounding & estimation
rounding.summary: Round numbers up, down and to the nearest place to estimate results.

exponents.title: Powers & exponents
exponents.summary: Work with powers, the laws of exponents and scientific notation.

integers.title: Number theory basics
integers.summary: The Euclidean algorithm, number bases and modular arithmetic.

identities.title: Identities & the binomial theorem
identities.summary: Use the binomial theorem and polynomial identities.

polynomial-equations.title: Polynomial equations
polynomial-equations.summary: Solve higher-degree equations with the remainder and factor theorems.

rate.title: Speed & unit rates
rate.summary: Find speed, time and distance, and compare quantities per unit.

conic.title: Conic sections
conic.summary: Parabolas, ellipses and hyperbolas, with parametric and polar forms.

angles.title: Angles & polygons
angles.summary: Find angles with parallel lines and the interior and exterior angles of polygons.

circle-solid.title: Circles & solids
circle-solid.summary: Sectors, and the volume and surface area of cones, pyramids and spheres.

sets.solid-a: Volume and surface area of solids

similarity.title: Similarity & circle theorems
similarity.summary: Use similar figures and the inscribed angle theorem.

transformations.title: Transformations
transformations.summary: Move figures by translation, rotation and reflection.

triangle-trig.title: Solving triangles
triangle-trig.summary: Find sides, angles and areas of triangles with the laws of sines and cosines.

triangle-properties.summary: Triangle centers, the power of a point, and Ceva's and Menelaus's theorems.

quartiles.title: Quartiles & box plots
quartiles.summary: Find quartiles and read the spread of data from box plots.

statistics.title: Variance & correlation
statistics.summary: Find the variance, standard deviation and correlation coefficient.

distributions.title: Probability distributions
distributions.summary: Expected values, variances and probabilities of binomial and normal distributions.

inference.title: Estimation & hypothesis testing
inference.summary: Estimate means and proportions and carry out hypothesis tests.

sets.title: Sets

logic.title: Propositions & logic
logic.summary: Negation and contrapositive, necessary and sufficient conditions, and truth tables.

mapping.title: Functions & relations
mapping.summary: Injective and surjective maps, and equivalence relations.

vector-space.title: Vector spaces
vector-space.summary: Linear independence, bases and dimension, and matrix rank.

linear-map.title: Linear maps
linear-map.summary: Find matrix representations, kernels and images.

inner-product.title: Inner products & orthogonality
inner-product.summary: Orthogonal and orthonormal bases, and Gram-Schmidt orthogonalization.

limit.title: Limits
limit.summary: Find limits of sequences and functions.

series.title: Series & Taylor expansions

improper-integral.title: Improper integrals
improper-integral.summary: Integrals over infinite intervals or with singularities.

multivariable.title: Partial derivatives & multiple integrals
multivariable.summary: Partial derivatives and multiple integrals of functions of several variables.

ode.title: Differential equations

pythagoras.description: Use the Pythagorean theorem to find a side length in the diagram.
